question: Who among the following was honoured with the ‘Honorary Foreign Member Award 2019’ by the American Historical Association?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramachandra Guha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramachandra Guha was honored with the ‘Honorary Foreign Member Award 2019’ by the American Historical Association**__.
 
• **Ramachandra "Ram" Guha **is an Indian historian, environmentalist, writer, and public intellectual whose research interests include social, political, contemporary, environmental, and cricket history, and the field of economics.
 __
 
• He is an important authority on the history of modern India.
 
• For the year 2011–12, he held a visiting position at the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), the Philippe Roman Chair in History and International Affairs.
 
• Guha was a visiting professor at the Indian Institute of Science in Bengaluru.
 
• The American Historical Association (AHA) has conferred its Honorary** Foreign Member prize for the year 2019** on Ramchandra Guha.
 
• He is the third Indian historian to be recognized by the association, joining the ranks of Romila Thapar and Jadunath Sarkar, who received the honor in 2009 and 1952 respectively.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nayanjot Lahiri** is a historian and archaeologist of ancient India and a professor of history at Ashoka University.

 
 
• She was previously on the faculty of the department of history at the University of Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Irfan Habib** is an Indian historian of ancient and medieval India, following the methodology of Marxist historiography.
 
 
• He identifies as a Marxist and is well known for his strong stance against Hindutva and Muslim communalists.
 
• He has authored a number of books, notably the Agrarian System of Mughal India, 1556–1707.
